wpcom-mcp/user-sites-resource.name: wpcom-mcp/user-sites-resource
wpcom-mcp/user-sites-resource.title: List site resources
wpcom-mcp/user-sites-resource.description: [MCP Resource] List basic site information for all user's accessible sites as a JSON resource.

wpcom/user-profile.name: wpcom/user-profile
wpcom/user-profile.title: View your profile
wpcom/user-profile.description: View the authenticated user's profile information including basic details, preferences, and account settings.

wpcom/user-sites.title: List your sites
wpcom/user-sites.description: List the authenticated user's accessible sites across WordPress.com and self-hosted Jetpack-connected sites. Use this to discover site IDs before calling site-scoped abilities.

wpcom/user-domains.name: wpcom/user-domains
wpcom/user-domains.title: View your domains
wpcom/user-domains.description: View domains names across user sites. Includes the basic information about each domain name.

wpcom/domain-update-dns-records.name: wpcom/domain-update-dns-records
wpcom/domain-update-dns-records.title: Update DNS records
wpcom/domain-update-dns-records.description: Add or remove DNS records (A, AAAA, ALIAS, CAA, CNAME, MX, NS, SRV, TXT) for a single custom domain.

wpcom/domain-update-nameservers.name: wpcom/domain-update-nameservers
wpcom/domain-update-nameservers.title: Update name servers
wpcom/domain-update-nameservers.description: Set the nameservers for a single custom domain. Requires the caller to manage the site the domain is connected to. Provide between 2 and 13 valid nameserver hostnames.

wpcom/domain-provision-ssl.name: wpcom/domain-provision-ssl
wpcom/domain-provision-ssl.title: Provision SSL certificate
wpcom/domain-provision-ssl.description: Trigger an SSL certificate provisioning attempt for a single domain name. Call this after verifying the domain is configured correctly.

wpcom/domain-set-mail-service.name: wpcom/domain-set-mail-service
wpcom/domain-set-mail-service.title: Set up external mail service
wpcom/domain-set-mail-service.description: Configure DNS records on a domain for an external mail service (Google Workspace, iCloud Mail, Office 365, or Zoho Mail).

wpcom/domain-purchase.name: wpcom/domain-purchase

wpcom/plans-list.name: wpcom/plans-list

wpcom/user-achievements.name: wpcom/user-achievements

Read billing history, invoice details, upcoming renewal schedule, payment methods (last 4 digits only), and usage. Stop or resume renewal on subscriptions. Remove stored payment methods. Get WordPress.com dashboard links to manage or change your plan.

wpcom/notifications-update.name: wpcom/notifications-update

wpcom/site-settings-update.title: Update site settings
wpcom/site-settings-update.description: Update site settings: title, tagline, timezone, date and time formats, and start_of_week.

wpcom/set-primary-domain.name: wpcom/set-primary-domain
wpcom/set-primary-domain.title: Set primary domain
wpcom/set-primary-domain.description: Set a custom domain as the primary domain for a WordPress.com site, replacing the default .wordpress.com address.

wpcom/attach-domain-to-site.name: wpcom/attach-domain-to-site
wpcom/attach-domain-to-site.title: Attach or transfer a domain to a site
wpcom/attach-domain-to-site.description: Attach a standalone domain to a WordPress.com site, or transfer a domain you already own from another WordPress.com site. Optionally set the domain as the primary domain on the target site.

wpcom/move-plan-to-site.name: wpcom/move-plan-to-site
wpcom/move-plan-to-site.title: Move a plan to another site
wpcom/move-plan-to-site.description: Move a WordPress.com plan you own to another site you administer, for example when you bought it on the wrong site.

wpcom/detach-domain-from-site.name: wpcom/detach-domain-from-site
wpcom/detach-domain-from-site.title: Detach a domain from a site
wpcom/detach-domain-from-site.description: Detach a registered domain from the WordPress.com site it is attached to. The domain moves to its own domain-only holding site and can be attached to another site later.

wpcom/jetpack-backup.name: wpcom/jetpack-backup
wpcom/jetpack-backup.title: Jetpack Backup
wpcom/jetpack-backup.description: Diagnose Jetpack Backup for the current site (read-only actions). rewind_status: whether backups can run right now — the backup system state (with a reason when unavailable), a non-sensitive server-credentials summary, the restore preflight outcome, when the last and first backups were made, and whether the latest backup attempt failed or succeeded. storage_status: storage usage vs quota with a derived status level, the retention window, and whether backups have stopped because storage is full. credentials_status: the full inventory of stored server credentials (never the secrets) with a live connection test for the user-entered main credential.

wpcom/jetpack-monitor.name: wpcom/jetpack-monitor
wpcom/jetpack-monitor.title: Jetpack Monitor
wpcom/jetpack-monitor.description: Read or toggle Jetpack Monitor downtime alerts for the current site (status / activate / deactivate). Activating or deactivating affects all administrators.

wpcom/jetpack-account-protection.name: wpcom/jetpack-account-protection
wpcom/jetpack-account-protection.title: Jetpack Account Protection
wpcom/jetpack-account-protection.description: Read or toggle Jetpack Account Protection for the current site (status / activate / deactivate). Activating or deactivating affects all administrators. Only available on plugin-enabled WordPress.com sites and Jetpack-connected self-hosted sites.

wpcom/jetpack-newsletter.name: wpcom/jetpack-newsletter
wpcom/jetpack-newsletter.title: Jetpack Newsletter
wpcom/jetpack-newsletter.description: Newsletter diagnostics + settings reads. Returns subscriber counts, recent sends with per-send delivery counts, concrete reasons the site cannot currently send, and the current public-facing Newsletter settings. Can also update those settings.

wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-add.name: wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-add
wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-add.title: Add newsletter subscribers
wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-add.description: Add up to 100 email addresses as newsletter subscribers to a site, after the user confirms they have consent to email each person.

wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-import-stat.name: wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-import-status
wpcom/newsletter-subscribers-import-stat.title: Newsletter subscriber import status

wpcom/jetpack-scan.name: wpcom/jetpack-scan
wpcom/jetpack-scan.title: Jetpack Scan
wpcom/jetpack-scan.description: Read Jetpack Scan state for the current site or queue a fresh scan. Returns scan state, last-scan metadata, the live threat list with autofix eligibility, ignored threats, and recently fixed threats.

wpcom/get-themes.name: wpcom/get-themes
wpcom/get-themes.title: List available themes

Requires a specific site ID or URL - use wpcom-user-sites first to get available sites if needed.

wpcom/get-site-stats.name: wpcom/get-site-stats
wpcom/get-site-stats.title: Get site statistics
wpcom/get-site-stats.description: View site totals — published posts, pages, and subscribers — plus optional traffic and publishing counts (views, visitors, posts published, pages published) for a given date range. Does NOT include top-posts, referrers, geo, or per-URL breakdowns.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview
wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.title: Stats overview
wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.description: Today’s views and visitors, this week’s and month’s views, the posting streak, and today’s top post and referrer.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content
wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.title: Stats top content
wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.description: Ranked top posts, referrers, search terms, clicks, tags, authors, countries, downloads or video plays over recent days.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views
wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views.title: Stats post views

Returns reverse-chronological (newest first by default) events including posts, comments, plugin updates, backups, user actions, and other site activities. Defaults to the last 6 months. wpcom/sidebars-list.description: List a classic theme's widget areas, such as its footer and sidebar.

wpcom/widgets-list.name: wpcom/widgets-list
wpcom/widgets-list.title: List widgets
wpcom/widgets-list.description: List the widgets in a classic theme's widget areas.

wpcom/widgets-create.name: wpcom/widgets-create
wpcom/widgets-create.title: Create widget
wpcom/widgets-create.description: Add a widget to a classic theme's widget area. Site-wide impact.

wpcom/widgets-update.name: wpcom/widgets-update
wpcom/widgets-update.title: Update widget
wpcom/widgets-update.description: Change a widget or move it to another widget area. Site-wide impact.

wpcom/widgets-delete.name: wpcom/widgets-delete
wpcom/widgets-delete.title: Delete widget
wpcom/widgets-delete.description: Move a widget to Inactive Widgets. Site-wide impact.

wpcom/navigation-delete.name: wpcom/navigation-delete
wpcom/navigation-delete.title: Delete navigation
wpcom/navigation-delete.description: Move a block navigation menu to trash. Site-wide impact.

wpcom/global-styles-get.name: wpcom/global-styles-get
wpcom/global-styles-get.title: Get global styles
wpcom/global-styles-get.description: Get the site's user-level global style customizations.

wpcom/global-styles-variations.name: wpcom/global-styles-variations
wpcom/global-styles-variations.title: List global style variations
wpcom/global-styles-variations.description: List style variation presets available for the active theme.

wpcom/global-styles-update.name: wpcom/global-styles-update
wpcom/global-styles-update.title: Update global styles
wpcom/global-styles-update.description: Update the site's global style customizations. Site-wide impact.

wpcom/themes-list.name: wpcom/themes-list
wpcom/themes-list.title: List themes
wpcom/themes-list.description: List installed themes with active status.

wpcom/site-settings.name: wpcom/site-settings
wpcom/site-settings.title: Get site settings
wpcom/site-settings.description: Get comprehensive site settings and configuration including general settings (title, tagline, URL), writing, reading, media, discussion, permalink, and privacy and visibility settings. Requires a specific site ID or URL - use wpcom-user-sites first to get available sites if needed.

wpcom/get-site-stats.name: wpcom/get-site-stats
wpcom/get-site-stats.title: Get site statistics
wpcom/get-site-stats.description: View site totals — published posts, pages, and subscribers — plus optional traffic and publishing counts (views, visitors, posts published, pages published) for a given date range. Does NOT include top-posts, referrers, geo, or per-URL breakdowns.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview
wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.title: Stats overview
wpcom/jetpack-stats-overview.description: Today’s views and visitors, this week’s and month’s views, the posting streak, and today’s top post and referrer.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content
wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.title: Stats top content
wpcom/jetpack-stats-top-content.description: Ranked top posts, referrers, search terms, clicks, tags, authors, countries, downloads or video plays over recent days.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views
wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views.title: Stats post views
wpcom/jetpack-stats-post-views.description: Views for one post or page: its all-time total and views per day, week, month or year.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-visits.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-visits
wpcom/jetpack-stats-visits.title: Stats visits
wpcom/jetpack-stats-visits.description: Views, visitors, likes and comments per day, week, month or year.

wpcom/jetpack-stats-followers.name: wpcom/jetpack-stats-followers
wpcom/jetpack-stats-followers.title: Stats followers
wpcom/jetpack-stats-followers.description: Follower counts by source: email, WordPress.com, comment and social followers.

wpcom/site-activity-log.name: wpcom/site-activity-log
wpcom/site-activity-log.title: Get site activity log
wpcom/site-activity-log.description: Get activity log entries for a WordPress.com or Jetpack site. Returns reverse-chronological (newest first by default) events including posts, comments, plugin updates, backups, user actions, and other site activities. Defaults to the last 6 months. Use the "after" parameter to fetch older entries.
